title: Towards Large Reasoning Models: A Survey of Reinforced Reasoning with Large Language Models
paper_type_zh: 大推理模型与强化推理综述
best_for_zh: 涵盖推理轨迹、奖励、搜索与推理预算关系的大推理模型综述。
one_line: A 2025 survey of reinforced reasoning that brings automated trajectory construction, learning-to-reason, and test-time scaling into one account.
将强化推理、自动数据构建与推理期扩展纳入同一概念图的综述。
why: It distinguishes reasoning trajectories, reward design, policy learning, and inference-time computation as related but different parts of a large reasoning model.
inclusion_reason: A 2025 survey that connects chain-of-thought and reinforcement learning with automated reasoning-trajectory construction and test-time scaling.

title: Problem
问题
html: The survey examines a recent strand of LLM reasoning research in which intermediate "thought" tokens are treated as part of the reasoning process rather than as ordinary generated text. It brings together three elements that are often discussed separately: the construction of reasoning trajectories, reinforcement learning for learning to reason, and the use of a larger inference-time token budget. The paper describes how trial-and-error search can generate trajectories for training and how extended deliberation at inference time can affect reasoning accuracy. It is a survey of this research direction, not a release of a model, benchmark, or trace dataset.
这篇综述关注近年 LLM 推理研究中的一条路线：中间的 "thought" 词元 被视为推理过程的一部分，而不只是普通生成文本。论文把通常分开讨论的三项内容放在一起：推理轨迹的构建、用于学习推理的强化学习，以及更大的推理期 词元 预算。它讨论试错式搜索如何产生训练轨迹，也讨论更长的推理期思考如何影响推理准确率。该文是对这一研究方向的综述，不发布新模型、基准或轨迹数据集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper's organizing idea is that large reasoning models combine training-time and test-time mechanisms. It presents intermediate thought sequences as the medium through which a model can explore a problem, receive reinforcement signals, and spend more computation during inference. Its taxonomy groups the literature around automated data construction, learning-to-reason techniques, and test-time scaling. This framing separates the origin of a trajectory, the learning procedure that uses it, and the inference process that produces a final answer, even when all three appear in the same system.
论文的组织思路是，大推理模型同时包含训练期与推理期机制。它把中间 thought 序列视为模型探索问题、获得强化信号并在推理时投入更多计算的媒介。其 分类框架围绕自动数据构建、learning-to-reason 技术和 推理期扩展来组织相关工作。这一框架区分了轨迹的来源、使用轨迹的学习过程，以及产出最终答案的推理过程，即使三者出现在同一个系统中。

title: Method
方法
html: The survey begins with background on LLM reasoning and then reviews the technical components that the authors associate with large reasoning models. Automated data construction covers methods that obtain reasoning trajectories through model generation or search. Learning-to-reason covers reinforcement-learning approaches that use such trajectories or reward signals during training. Test-time scaling covers approaches that allocate additional tokens or search effort during inference. The paper also discusses open-source large-reasoning-model projects and closes with open challenges; it does not introduce a unified experimental protocol of its own.
综述先介绍 LLM 推理的背景，再回顾作者所归纳的大推理模型技术组成。自动数据构建部分讨论通过模型生成或搜索得到推理轨迹的方法。learning-to-reason 部分讨论训练时使用这些轨迹或 奖励信号的强化学习方法。推理期扩展部分讨论在推理时投入额外 词元 或搜索计算的方法。论文还讨论开源大推理模型项目，并以开放问题收束；它没有提出统一的新实验协议。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official arXiv record describes a 36-page survey with five figures and coverage of open-source large-reasoning-model projects. The paper's evidence consists of a literature synthesis and project discussion rather than a newly released benchmark, dataset, or controlled empirical comparison.
官方 arXiv 记录将其描述为 36 页、5 图的综述，并覆盖开源大推理模型项目。论文的证据主要来自文献综合和项目讨论，而不是新发布的 基准、数据集或受控实证比较。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Chain-of-thought prompting and reinforcement learning both predate this paper. Its contribution is a 2025 synthesis that places automated trajectory construction and test-time scaling alongside reinforced learning-to-reason, rather than treating them as unrelated topics. The resulting account emphasizes that a reasoning trace may be generated by a teacher, sampled from a model, or discovered through search, and that these origins affect how the trace is used in a system. Because the paper is a survey, it does not establish the reliability, licensing, or reproducibility of every source it discusses.
CoT 提示词设计 与强化学习都早于这篇论文。它的贡献在于给出一份 2025 年的综合梳理：自动轨迹构建和 推理期扩展被放在 reinforced learning-to-reason 旁边讨论，而不是被视为彼此无关的话题。由此可见，推理轨迹可能由教师生成、由模型采样，或由搜索发现；不同来源会影响它在系统中的使用方式。由于这是一篇综述，它不能替其中每个来源证明可靠性、许可证状态或可复现性。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The paper was last revised on arXiv in January 2025, so it cannot cover later reasoning-model releases or subsequent changes to this fast-moving area. Its broad categories also span methods with different data sources, reward designs, and evaluation setups. The survey does not provide source-level documentation for the datasets, rewards, licenses, or contamination controls of the works it reviews.
该文在 arXiv 上的最后修订时间为 2025 年 1 月，因此不覆盖之后出现的大推理模型发布或该方向后续变化。其宽泛类别还横跨数据来源、奖励 设计和评测设置不同的方法。综述也不为被讨论工作的数据集、奖励、许可证或污染控制提供来源级文档。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: The survey is most closely connected to work on demonstrations and reasoning traces, process supervision, verifier-guided reinforcement learning, and search-based or agentic trajectories. Its terminology provides a common description for systems that combine those elements.
这篇综述与示范和推理轨迹、过程监督、验证器引导的强化学习，以及搜索式或 智能体 轨迹研究关系最紧密。它提供了一套共同术语来描述同时结合这些元素的系统。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The data-construction and reward-design discussions are closely linked. A reasoning trace becomes a training signal only through the procedure that selects, scores, or otherwise uses it; the survey repeatedly connects trajectory generation with reinforcement learning and inference-time search.
大推理模型把推理轨迹、奖励、自动数据构建和推理期搜索连接起来。最重要的理解是，轨迹本身只是生成物；只有经过选择、评分或学习使用后，它才会成为能够改变模型行为的训练信号。
